name: Sivakasi

queries.query: Sivakasi Tamil Nadu official cadastral map land records parcel GIS site:gov.in
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Tamil Nadu land-record e-services, the TNGIS public map editor, the official Sivakasi municipal page, DILRMP's Sivakasi tehsil map-digitization record, and the national NAKSHA programme. The land-record service describes Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR lookup by district and rural/urban hierarchy; no open parcel-vector download was identified.

queries.query: சிவகாசி அதிகாரப்பூர்வ நில அளவை வரைபடம் பட்டா நில பதிவுகள் GIS site:gov.in
queries.result: Tamil-language discovery returned official Tamil Nadu land-record/GIS and Sivakasi municipal/DILRMP references. The indexed material describes patta, FMB/chitta/TSLR and survey-number workflows, but did not expose an anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Tamil first-party discovery followed by bounded anonymous HTTPS GET inspection where reachable and current-viewer inspection through official indexed material. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields or global TLS disablement were used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Tamil Nadu land-record service entry point for Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR workflows; access is hierarchical and survey-number based, not an identified open parcel-vector API.
Official TNGIS map editor with public map UI, administrative layers and a visual Land Ownership section; the bounded fetch timed out and no parcel schema or geometry response was retained.
Official Sivakasi municipal page identifies the local urban-body custodian and provides an Online Services - Land link; it is municipal service prose, not a verified parcel-vector endpoint.

Official DILRMP record for Tamil Nadu, Virudhunagar district, Sivakasi tehsil; indexed content reports digitized FMB/Tippan maps and status fields for villages, including whether geo-referenced and linked to RoR.
